# **Guidelines** 

# Ref.: IRDAI/RI/GDL/MISC/038 /01/2020 

~ : 31 st January, 2020 

# To, 

All Insurers as defined under Sec. 2 (9) of the Act, IFSC IIOs, Exempted Insurers; 

Re : Guidelines on filing of Re-insurance arrangements with the IRDAI. 

1. This has reference to the Reg. 3 (3) (A) (b) of the IRDAI (Re-insurance), Regulations, 2018 Insurers (hereinafter referred as 'insurer' for the purpose of these guidelines), have to submit its re-insurance Programme for the forthcoming financial year, forty-five (45) days before commencement of the financial year; as per which, the Insurers as defined under Sec. 2 (9) of the Act, IFSC IIOs, Exempted

Any re-insurance arrangement which do not have pure risk transfer such as Capital Gearing Treaty, Alternate Risk Transfer Solution, Financial Re-insurance, non-traditional structured re-insurance solution or any other term or name called, need to be informed to the IRDAI; 

   - a. to confirm that, the reinsurance treaty(ies) applicable for particular financial year meet 

   - b. in case the insurer intends to adopt ART, non-traditional structured solutions, Financial Re-insurance, then it shall take prior approval of the Authority, as per provisions of Reg. 8 of the IRDAI (Re-insurance) Regulations, 2018; 

   - c. to inform the IRDAI on or before 1st March of every year about any proposed reinsurance arrangement (other than pure risk transfer / traditional re-insurance contract) to be entered in to by the insurer as specified in para 3 (a) of this guidelines; 

   - d. to obtain due confirmation from the lead reinsurer(s) specifying the methodology used for such risk transfer and its compliance and submit the same with the IRDAI whenever called for;
